readerCopy.summary: The institution promising broader opportunity faces the people documenting how expansion has narrowed their choices.
readerCopy.body: The institution promising broader opportunity faces the people documenting how expansion has narrowed their choices. One side points to investment, reach, and total growth; the other points to consolidated ownership, higher prices, and access controlled by fewer hands. Jupiter holds the public promise of more, while Pluto reveals where power has collected as the system expanded. The opposition places opportunity across from concentration without allowing large numbers to settle the argument. The expansion may create real capacity, but it also shows how few alternatives remain for anyone unwilling to accept the winning structure's terms.
